questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या आपको रोज़ पैदल चलना पड़ता है ?

answers.answer_text: Do you have to walk every day?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या आपको भारत में भी पैदल चलना पड़ता था ?

answers.answer_text: Did you also have to walk in India?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या आपको अब एक गाड़ी खरीदनी पड़ेगी ?

answers.answer_text: Will you have to buy a car now?

questions_and_answers.question_text: भारत जाने से पहले आपको इतनी साड़ियां क्यों खरीदनी पड़ी थीं?

answers.answer_text: Why did you have to buy so many saris before going to India?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या उन्हें अपने बीमार बच्चे को अस्पताल ले जाना पड़ा ?

answers.answer_text: Did they have to take their sick child to the hospital?
